qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unrivaled North American distribution scale and local route density provide insurmountable per-stop logistics cost advantages over regional competitors. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 18.2% and gross margin remains steady at ~18.3%. Food inflation is reliably passed through via cost-plus contract mechanisms and dynamic independent pricing. Primary erosion threats include independent restaurant distress and driver wage inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Market leader in foodservice distribution with scale economies shared and high ROIC (18.2% median), but structurally violates Gate 6 balance sheet peace-of-mind. Total debt of $12.3B against $1.76B net income yields lt_debt/NI of 7.0x (net debt/NI of 6.0x), far exceeding the 4.0x ceiling. Interest coverage of ~4.9x falls below the 5.0x minimum, and debt-funded share buybacks have resulted in negative tangible equity of -$3.5B.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of $84.6B, operating income (EBIT) of $3,095M, net income of $1,757M, and OCF of $2,638M against capex of $700M (FCF conversion 104%). 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 18.16% and operating tangible ROIC exceeds 34%. However, long-term debt is $12,315M against cash of $1,786M (net debt $10,529M, or 6.0x net income). FY2025 cash interest paid of $629M yields EBIT/interest coverage of 4.92x (below the 5.0x hurdle). Stockholders' equity of $2,666M minus $6,177M goodwill/intangibles leaves negative tangible equity of -$3,511M, reflecting aggressive debt-funded buybacks rather than a fortress balance sheet.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
